q: How many students were enrolled in the first semester of 1447?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-1' AND status <> 'withdrawn'

q: How many new students were admitted in the first semester of 2024/2025?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE admit_term = '2024-1'

q: How many new students did the Information Systems programme admit in 2023-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(p.merged_into, ''), p.programme_id) = 'IS' AND admit_term = '2023-1'

q: What share of enrolments were withdrawn in 2025-2?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-2'

q: What was the pass rate in UNI 105 in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND letter <> 'F' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed', 'denied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-1' AND course_code = 'UNI 105'

q: What was the average grade point in CSC courses in 2024-1, weighted by credit hours?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(grade_points * credit_hours) / SUM(credit_hours) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2024-1' AND course_code LIKE 'CSC %' AND status = 'completed'

q: How many female students were enrolled in the second semester of 1446?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) WHERE e.term_id = '2024-2' AND e.status <> 'withdrawn' AND s.gender = 'F'

q: How many non-Saudi students were enrolled in 2026-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) WHERE e.term_id = '2026-1' AND e.status <> 'withdrawn' AND s.nationality = 'Non-Saudi'

q: How many credit hours did students of the College of Engineering register in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(e.credit_hours) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE e.term_id = '2025-1' AND e.status <> 'withdrawn' AND p.college_id = 'ENG'

q: How many students graduated in 2026-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE grad_term = '2026-1'

q: Which programme had the most students enrolled in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.merged_into, ''), p.programme_id) AS programme FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE e.term_id = '2025-1' AND e.status <> 'withdrawn' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the withdrawal rate in the College of Business in 2024-2?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN e.status = 'withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE e.term_id = '2024-2' AND p.college_id = 'BUS'

q: How many enrolments ended in denial of the final examination in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-1' AND status = 'denied'

q: On average, how many courses did each enrolled student take in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-1' AND status <> 'withdrawn'

q: How many students of the Information Systems programme were enrolled in 2025-2?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_id) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE e.term_id = '2025-2' AND e.status <> 'withdrawn' AND COALESCE(NULLIF(p.merged_into, ''), p.programme_id) = 'IS'

q: What was the pass rate across all courses in 2025-2?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND letter <> 'F' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed', 'denied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-2'

q: How many incomplete grades were recorded in the second semester of 1447?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrolments e WHERE term_id = '2025-2' AND status = 'incomplete'

q: How many students did the College of Health Sciences admit in 2022/2023 and 2023/2024 together?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE p.college_id = 'HSC' AND s.admit_term IN ('2022-1', '2023-1')

q: What was the credit-weighted grade point average of College of Sciences students in 2025-1?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(e.grade_points * e.credit_hours) / SUM(e.credit_hours) FROM enrolments e JOIN students s USING (student_id) JOIN programmes p ON p.programme_id = s.programme_id WHERE e.term_id = '2025-1' AND e.status = 'completed' AND p.college_id = 'SCI'

q: How many students admitted in 2022-1 are still active?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE admit_term = '2022-1' AND status = 'active'
